# Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

## Project
Laravel 10 CRM application with MySQL backend. Features include project management, HR, invoicing, tickets, leads, attendance, and client portal.

## Tech Stack
- PHP 8.1+, Laravel 10
- MySQL 8
- Laravel Mix (Webpack), Bootstrap 4
- Pusher/Laravel Echo for real-time

## Setup
1. `composer install`
2. `npm install && npm run dev`
3. Configure `.env` with DB credentials
4. `php artisan migrate --seed`

## Structure
- `app/` - Controllers, Models, Traits
- `database/migrations/` - 221 migration files
- `resources/views/` - Blade templates
- `routes/web.php` - Route definitions
